title: Ultra Creamy Middle Eastern Garlic Umm Ali
description: A rich and creamy Middle Eastern dish featuring garlic and a paleo-friendly umm ali crust, perfect for meal prep. This jammy and creamy dessert is a unique twist on traditional umm ali.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the garlic cloves and coconut milk, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the garlic and coconut milk mixture by half, stirring occasionally, until it reaches a jammy consistency.
In a separate bowl, mix together the almond flour, honey, and ghee until well combined.
Add the chopped pistachios, ground cardamom, and sea salt to the bowl and stir until a crumbly crust forms.
Transfer the reduced garlic mixture to a baking dish and top with the crust mixture.
Bake the umm ali for 25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the umm ali from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the umm ali warm, garnished with additional chopped pistachios if desired.
